description: A stereo voice in three stages: a dual oscillator blended against a stereo input, then a neural amp model loaded from a file, then a saturating 4-pole lowpass

params.text: Sets the pitch of the CORE oscillator in semitones about C4
Chooses the CORE waveform: Sine, Triangle or Saw
Sets the pitch of the FLARE oscillator in semitones about C4
Detunes FLARE by up to a semitone either way
Makes FLARE follow the CORE pitch jack, so the two track together from one keyboard
Morphs the FLARE waveform from sine through triangle and saw to pulse
Wavefolds FLARE, adding harmonics as it is turned up
Warps the FLARE phase, skewing the wave without changing its pitch
Sets how hard CORE modulates the FLARE frequency
Chooses the frequency modulation: Linear, which goes through zero, or Exponential
Sets how FLARE is synchronised to CORE: Off, Soft or Hard
Balances CORE against FLARE, all CORE anticlockwise and all FLARE clockwise
Places CORE towards the left channel and FLARE towards the right as it is turned up
Blends the external stereo input against the oscillator pair, the input alone anticlockwise and the oscillators alone clockwise
Sets the level going into the neural model, from -30dB to 18dB
Blends the neural model's output against the signal that went in, with the dry arm delayed to match so no position combs
Bypasses the neural stage, passing the signal straight to the filter
Sets the corner of the lowpass, from 20Hz to the top of the audio band
Sets the resonance of the lowpass, up into self-oscillation at the top of its travel
Makes the filter corner follow the CORE pitch jack, from no tracking to full
Chooses the lowpass slope: 12dB per octave or 24dB per octave
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the control it belongs to

inputs.text: The left channel in, which also feeds the right channel when the jack beside it is empty
Sets the CORE pitch, a volt to the octave, and the FLARE pitch too while TRACK is on
Sets the FLARE pitch, a volt to the octave
Moves the FLARE waveform morph, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the FLARE wavefolding, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the FLARE phase warp, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the frequency modulation depth, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the balance between CORE and FLARE, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the stereo placement of the two oscillators, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the filter corner a volt to the octave, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the filter resonance, 10V sweeping its whole range, scaled by the trimmer beside it
Moves the blend between the external input and the oscillators, 10V sweeping the whole blend
Moves the level into the neural model, 10V covering the knob's whole 48dB range
Moves the neural wet and dry blend, 10V sweeping the whole blend

outputs.text: The left channel out; with the right output unpatched this jack carries the two channels summed to mono

notes: no amp models are bundled: until you load a .nam file the neural stage passes the signal through unchanged
a model can be loaded from the LOAD button, from the display, from the right-click menu, or by dropping a .nam file onto the module
the neural path adds 32 samples of latency, plus a little more when the model's sample rate differs from the engine's
one neural network runs per channel, which makes this the heaviest module in most racks; the mono-network menu option halves that cost
inference runs in bursts of 32 samples, so Rack's peak meter flashes past 100% on clean audio; the average figure is the one that means anything
menu: Load model (.nam)… — opens a file chooser for the neural amp capture the module plays
Clear model — unloads the capture, after which the neural stage passes the signal through
Mono model (sum L+R through one network) — sums the two channels into one network instead of running one per channel, halving the cost
Normalize model loudness (-18 dB) — applies the loudness figure stored in the capture so models match in level
Fast neural activations (half CPU, reloads model) — swaps the exact activation functions for approximations and reloads the capture
